column1: # parity-1.input.tsv - the BIN15 pricer tape. Generated by
#   PHI   v0 .. v4096                    load the shipped Phi table
#   RECAL phase v0 .. v64                load one shipped recal table
#   F     mark strike tau sig2           fair_value
# phase_of on and around both boundaries
# log_moneyness: at the money, both directions, the refusals
# phi_1e6: on grid, off grid (interpolation), the clamp
# recal_1e6: every phase, on and off the buckets, out of range
# fair_value: a seeded walk of marks x every strike x every tau
# fair_value: the refusals and the saturations
# floor_grid / ceil_grid: on grid, off grid, negative centres
